# Kiganjani Co. — llms.txt

> Solo digital agency in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Websites, e-commerce with M-Pesa checkout, and custom web applications for Tanzanian and East African businesses.

## What we do
- Website Design: fast 5-page business websites with local SEO, WhatsApp + contact form.
- E-Commerce: product listings, inventory, cart, checkout, M-Pesa / card payments, order notifications.
- Web Applications: secure login, dashboards, databases, API integrations, admin panels.
- Pricing (TZS): Website from 400,000 · E-Commerce from 1,800,000 · Web Application from 3,200,000.

## Service area
- Based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Remote-first across Tanzania and East Africa.
